verdict.rationale: cubic's documented chat lives in its own web PR-review UI (the chat sidebar and 'Add to AI chat' on diffs), not inside the developer's IDE. Its IDE-adjacent offerings, the MCP server and the local CLI review, feed findings to a third-party coding agent rather than providing a cubic chat assistant in the IDE. These are adjacent features, so no credit is given for in-IDE contextual chat.

support.subject: As a developer, I can chat with the coding assistant directly inside my IDE for contextual help
